rules.description: Files the litellm 1.107.0 wheels ship under litellm-1.107.0.data/purelib/, which pip installs at the site-packages root: cook.pth (runs `import cook` at every interpreter start), cook.py (the encoded stealer) and sitecustomize.py (an hourly remote code loader). Matched by SHA-256 only, since the names are generic.
